outcomes.name: Understanding of the benefits approach has been assessed across all live sites/teams
The benefits approach is consistently applied everywhere the change has gone live

actions.action: Recognise that Planning & Risk is inconsistent across teams/sites since go-live and gather evidence of where the gaps are in the benefits approach.
Identify why the benefits approach hasn't landed consistently for Planning & Risk in specific teams/sites and agree a plan to address it.
Re-engage leaders in lagging teams/sites to re-establish the benefits approach for Planning & Risk.
Confirm the benefits approach for Planning & Risk is being applied consistently across previously inconsistent areas.
Monitor Planning & Risk regularly to ensure the benefits approach stays consistently reinforced everywhere.
Survey teams/sites to understand how Process & Sustainment has been affected by inconsistent benefits approach since go-live.
Develop a targeted plan to address the specific Process & Sustainment-related gaps identified in lagging areas.
Deliver targeted support to strengthen Process & Sustainment in teams/sites where the benefits approach is weakest.
Confirm Process & Sustainment has improved in previously lagging teams/sites.
Embed regular pulse-checks on Process & Sustainment so gaps in the benefits approach are caught early in future.
